title: Recruiters chatting about the covert program at Starbucks
place_text: near Baker Victory Services, New York

tellings.quote: they would go to the Starbucks around the corner or whatever and talk casually about their job, which is recruiting for this UFO covert program.

plain: People recruiting children for a secret UFO program are said to have gone to the Starbucks around the corner from a place called Baker Victory Services, in New York, and chatted casually there about their work, around 2008 to 2010. Michels tells this from the account of Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into the program as a child and wrote about it in a blog post. If true, it would mean such a program recruited openly enough to be overheard over coffee.
